title: Add collision presets in CollisionObject2D and CollisionObject3D

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
Depends on #117096
Resolves godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/14322

Adds four new project settings: physics/2d/presets, physics/3d/presets, physics/2d/default_preset, and physics/3d/default_preset.

The presets defined by these settings can be accessed through the new 'collision_preset' property in CollisionObject2D and CollisionObject3D, and allow synchronizing modifications to collision layers and masks between many objects easily.

This proposal also adds the PROPERTY_HINT_PRESETS_2D_PHYSICS and PROPERTY_HINT_PRESETS_3D_PHYSICS property hints so that users can hook into the preset system (e.g. for performing shape-casting with `PhysicsDirectSpaceState2D`). To work with presets from GDScript, the static classes `CollisionPresets2D` and `CollisionPresets3D` are added and provide utility functions.

It should be relatively easy to expand this PR to include other kinds of bitmask layers in the future.

Currently, the default value for the `collision_preset` property on `CollisionObject`s is `0`, which represents the default collision preset. For backwards compatibility reasons it may be better to have this be `-1` (which represents `<custom>`) for now, so that setting the default collision preset in `ProjectSettings` will not nuke all existing layer and mask settings. (no changes will occur until the default collision preset setting is set though)

### Known Issues
The elements of the `physics/2d/presets` and `physics/3d/presets` settings cannot have tooltips currently due to existing limitations with `EditorInspectorArray`. I think that this is minor enough to be ignored for now, but could use a touch-up in the future.

Setting the `collision_layer` or `collision_mask` property of a `CollisionObject` causes the preset to be changed to `<custom>`, but since this change happens automatically it is not recorded in undo-redo history, and undoing will leave the preset as custom even if the layer and mask match the preset's values exactly. For technical reasons, this would be difficult to fix, so I think it can be safely ignored for now as well.
